body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense has reported PLA activity in the sea and airspace around the Taiwan Strait for the period from 06:00 on October 26 to 06:00 on October 27. As of 06:00 on October 27, it detected 3 PLA aircraft sorties, all entering northern and southwestern airspace, along with 8 PLA naval vessels and 4 official ships continuing to operate around the Taiwan Strait.

The ministry said Taiwan's armed forces used mission aircraft, naval vessels and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activity. The notice was issued by the Political Warfare Bureau on October 27.
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting 3 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 naval vessels and 4 official ships around the Taiwan Strait between 06:00 on October 26 and 06:00 on October 27, with the armed forces monitoring and responding with mission aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems.
en.title: Taiwan MND detects 3 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 naval vessels and 4 official ships around Taiwan

facts.claim: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported PLA activity around the Taiwan Strait for the period from 06:00 on October 26 to 06:00 on October 27, detecting 3 PLA aircraft sorties entering northern and southwestern airspace, 8 PLA naval vessels and 4 official ships.

The detected aircraft, vessels and official ships continued to operate around the Taiwan Strait, and Taiwan's armed forces used mission aircraft, naval vessels and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond.
The notice was published on October 27 by the Political Warfare Bureau.

body: 國防部公布中共解放軍臺海周邊海、空域動態，統計期間為10月26日上午6時至10月27日上午6時。截至10月27日上午6時，國軍偵獲共機3架次，進入北部及西南空域計3架次，另偵獲共艦8艘及公務船4艘，持續在臺海周邊活動。
國防部表示，國軍運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處，並持續掌握臺海周邊動態。這份通報由政治作戰局於10月27日發布。
zh.summary: 國防部公布10月26日上午6時至10月27日上午6時臺海周邊動態，偵獲共機3架次、共艦8艘及公務船4艘，國軍運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
zh.title: 國防部偵獲3架次共機與8艘共艦在臺海周邊活動
